# CryptoCasinoMedia — Comprehensive AI Knowledge Surface (llms-full.txt)

> Professional iGaming, Digital Asset & Search-Trend Intelligence Publisher

## Executive Overview
CryptoCasinoMedia (CCM) is an independent B2B news, market intelligence, and press release distribution publisher covering the intersection of cryptocurrency, blockchain payments, decentralized finance (DeFi/GambleFi), regulatory compliance, and online gambling.

## Core Verticals & Coverage Taxonomy
1. Press Releases: Official corporate announcements, game launches, partnerships, and technical deployments (https://cryptocasinomedia.com/press-releases/)
2. Crypto Casinos: Provably fair gaming, layer-1/layer-2 networks, high-roller wagering, and on-chain liquidity (https://cryptocasinomedia.com/crypto-casinos/)
3. Regulation & Compliance: SEC, CFTC, UKGC, Curaçao Gaming Authority (CGA), UAE VARA, GCGRA, Brazil SECAP/SPA, and EU MiCA directives (https://cryptocasinomedia.com/regulation/)
4. Payments & Tech: USDT, USDC, Bitcoin Lightning, Solana Blinks, Telegram TON wallets, and non-custodial Web3 staking (https://cryptocasinomedia.com/payments/)
5. Sweepstakes: U.S. promotional sweepstakes casino compliance, dual-currency models (Gold Coins / Sweeps Coins), and state availability (https://cryptocasinomedia.com/sweepstakes/)
6. Sportsbook & Prediction Markets: Decentralized sportsbooks, Polymarket, Kalshi, event contracts, and major sporting tournament wagering (https://cryptocasinomedia.com/sportsbook/)
7. Local Intelligence Directory: 50 U.S. states and ~210 Nielsen DMAs tracking local search trends, state gambling tax codes, and municipal advertising laws (https://cryptocasinomedia.com/local/)
